articles.summary: ATS Corporation (TSX and NYSE: ATS) ("ATS" or the "Company") today reported its financial results for the three and six months ended September 27, 2026. All references to "$" or "dollars" in this news release are to Canadian dollars unless otherwise indicated. Today ATS reported second quarter results for fiscal 2027. Order Bookings were $827 million, up 12.7% year over year and 26.1% from the first quarter, led by life sciences. Life sciences Order Backlog ended the quarter at the highest level in the Company's history. The Company also continued to make improvements on aftermarket services and the ATS Business Model ("ABM"), with a clear view on the portfolio, strategy and execution across its businesses, while driving progress on its previously announced Fixed Cost Transformation Program. Second quarter highlights: Revenues were $665.8 million compared to $728.5 million a year ago. Net loss was $5.0 million compared to net income of $33.6 million a year ago. Basic loss per share
articles.title: ATS Reports Second Quarter Fiscal 2027 Results
